title: Completed local charts of an fs log regular scheme
statement: Let $(X,M,\alpha)$ be a locally Noetherian log regular fs log scheme [def-trf-fs-log-blowup, pqf-def-locnoeth], let $\bar x$ be a geometric point over $x$ [def-weil-geometric-point], and put $A=\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{X,\bar x}$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], with residue field $k$ and characteristic monoid $P=\overline M_{\bar x}$. Choose a sharp chart $a:P\to A$ identifying $P$ with this characteristic [lem-trf-log-regular-sharp-chart]. After replacing this sharp chart if necessary by another chart $P\to M|_{W'}$ on an affine pointed etale neighbourhood $W'$ of $\bar x$, again inducing the chosen identification of $P$ with $\overline M_{\bar x}$, there exist an integer $n\geq0$ and an isomorphism of complete local rings, compatible with $a(q)\mapsto z^q$, of the following form. If $A$ contains a field (equal characteristic) it is $\widehat A\cong B_k(P,n)$. If $A$ contains no field, then $k$ has prime characteristic $p$ (this is the mixed characteristic $(0,p)$ case) and it is $\widehat A\cong B_C(P,n)/(\theta)$, where $C$ is a Cohen ring with residue field $k$ [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring] and $\theta-p\in(z^q\ (q\neq0),t_1,\ldots,t_n)B_C(P,n)$. Here $\widehat A$ is the maximal-ideal completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and $B_L(P,n)$ denotes the completion of the monoid polynomial ring $L[P][t_1,\ldots,t_n]$ at $(\mathfrak m_L,z^q\ (q\neq0),t_1,\ldots,t_n)$, with $\mathfrak m_k=0$ and $\mathfrak m_C=pC$. The monoid ring is the ring of finite sums $c z^q$ with $z^qz^{q'}=z^{q+q'}$. The case $P=\{0\}$ and $n=0$ is allowed.

source.place: Expose VI 1.6(i)--(ii), printed p. 70, citing Kato (1994), Theorem 3.2 (WANTED locally). The isomorphisms respect the chart monomials; these are statements about completed strict local rings, not ordinary smooth chart maps.
